en.title: Systematic debugging
en.description: Trace unexpected behavior to a reproducible cause before changing code.
tasks: Trace unexpected behavior to a reproducible cause before changing code.
prerequisites: An AI agent that can read local Skill files. Provide your task context and source materials.
A local code project and an agent with file editing and command execution capabilities.
en.example: Use systematic-debugging for this task: Trace unexpected behavior to a reproducible cause before changing code. First ask me for the missing context. Use only the evidence I provide or sources you can verify, and explain what I should check in the result.
en.expectedResult: A task-specific draft or analysis, with assumptions, evidence gaps, and clear next steps for you to review.
limitations: Review factual claims and proposed actions before relying on the output.
Source and package checks are complete; no end-to-end Agent task verification is claimed.
The bundled diagnostic script runs project tests; review commands before using it. Other Superpowers workflows are separate installs.

zh.title: 系统化排错
zh.description: 先复现问题并定位根因，再修改代码。
tasks: 先复现问题并定位根因，再修改代码。
prerequisites: 可读取本地 Skill 文件的 AI Agent；准备任务背景与原始材料。
本地代码项目，以及可编辑文件和执行命令的 Agent。
zh.example: 请使用 systematic-debugging 完成以下任务：先复现问题并定位根因，再修改代码。 先询问缺少的背景信息，只使用我提供的证据或可以核验的来源，并说明结果需要检查哪些内容。
zh.expectedResult: 得到针对任务的草稿或分析，包含假设、证据缺口和可供检查的后续步骤。
limitations: 使用输出前核对事实依据和建议操作。
已完成来源与包文件检查，尚未声明完成 Agent 端到端任务验证。
包内诊断脚本会执行项目测试，使用前应检查命令；其他 Superpowers 流程需单独安装。
